title: IBM CEO says open weight models are now good and cheap on-prem
hook_text: IBM says open weight AI is ready
script:
Zero cloud fees. IBM chief executive Arvind Krishna says open weight models are now cheap on premises.
Businesses can run powerful systems locally in just two or three racks instead of paying cloud giants for every query.
That shifts enterprise budgets away from expensive hosted application programming interfaces that charge per token.
Companies keep sensitive corporate data, private logs, and model activity strictly inside their own hardware walls.
Previously, firms relied entirely on hosted services because local hardware lacked the performance needed for heavy workloads.
Now, affordable open weight alternatives match proprietary software quality without locking you into a single vendor ecosystem.
Will your company switch to local open weight servers next year?
